strings.rulesGoalText: Build eight runs from King down to Ace, each in one suit. A complete run leaves the table by itself for a foundation; when all eight are there, you win.
strings.rulesBoardText: Two decks, 104 cards. 54 are dealt into ten columns, only the last card of each face up; the other 50 wait in the stock, top left, for five deals. The eight foundations take the complete runs.
strings.rulesColumnsText: A card goes on any card one rank higher, whatever its suit: a 7 on any 8. When a face-down card is uncovered, it turns over.
strings.rulesCellsText: An empty column takes any card or run. Tap the stock to deal one new card onto every column; every column must hold a card first.
strings.rulesRunsText: Several cards move together only when they are in order and all of one suit. A run in mixed suits has to be taken apart card by card.
strings.rulesTipsText: Build in one suit whenever you can, turn over the face-down cards and keep a column empty as long as possible. Stuck? Try Hint or Undo.

tutorial: Build runs from King down to Ace in one suit. A complete run goes to a foundation by itself.
Put a card on any card one rank higher, whatever its suit.
Cards in order and all of one suit move together. Build in one suit whenever you can.
Uncovered face-down cards turn over. Any card or run can go into an empty column.
Tap the stock to deal one card onto every column. Every column must hold a card first.
Make all eight runs to clear the table.
